subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat support hiding the New messages indicator, and if so what accessible manual catch-up affordance must remain when automatic scrolling is off?
rationale: The current control is intentionally retained as the recovery path for users who are not following the live tail; source evidence cannot choose between hiding, minimizing, dismissing, or replacing that product behavior.

options.title: Add a UI-only indicator mode
options.body: Persist a WebChat setting that hides or minimizes the indicator while keeping an explicit manual scroll-to-bottom action available.

options.title: Keep the current catch-up control
options.body: Retain the current behavior and close the request only if maintainers decide the existing manual recovery affordance is the intended UX.

options.title: Expose gateway configuration
options.body: Add a documented gateway.webchat policy only if maintainers want administrators, rather than each WebChat user, to control this presentation behavior.

recommendation.title: Add a UI-only indicator mode
recommendation.body: Persist a WebChat setting that hides or minimizes the indicator while keeping an explicit manual scroll-to-bottom action available.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged adjacent setting established the current auto-scroll and manual-catch-up contract that this decision would extend.
